Some commenters found the show’s increasingly modern and eclectic touches amusing or uniquely interesting.
The character-focused material, especially around the cast’s changing dynamics, received strong approval.
Some viewers thought the episode was engaging but felt unusually scattered and too brief.
A few reactions criticized the episode’s lack of cohesion and felt it ended abruptly.
